title: What It Actually Looks Like to Be Honest on Your Résumé and Still Sell Yourself
caption:
Everybody pads the résumé a little. That's what you'll hear.

"Led the project" when you ran the spreadsheet. A number rounded up. A gap that quietly disappears. It feels small. It's still a lie, and it's a lie you'll have to keep telling in the interview.

A man of God doesn't have a résumé version of himself. He names his real part, uses numbers he can defend, owns the gap, and then sells hard where it's true. Honest and confident aren't opposites. They're the same man.

"A false balance is an abomination to the Lord, but a just weight is his delight." Proverbs 11:1

Save this before your next application. Send it to the brother who's job hunting.
